Future<void> save(Object? x) async {}

// CASE dart_single_named_fn expect=pass
void a1(List<int> ids, List<Future<void> Function()> handlers) {
  for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
    Future<void> job() async {
      await save(ids[i]);
    }

    handlers.add(job);
  }
}

// CASE dart_forin_named_fn expect=pass
void a2(List<int> ids, List<Future<void> Function()> handlers) {
  for (final id in ids) {
    Future<void> job() async {
      await save(id);
    }

    handlers.add(job);
  }
}

// CASE dart_empty_update_named_fn expect=pass
void a3(List<int> ids, List<Future<void> Function()> handlers) {
  for (var i = 0; i < ids.length;) {
    Future<void> job() async {
      await save(ids[i]);
    }

    handlers.add(job);
    i++;
  }
}
